author: Inside Edition
description: When a teenager started choking on a hard candy in his family's living room, his father jumped into action. The dad performed the Heimlich maneuver on his son, and was able to dislodge the obstruction from the boy's throat. Incredibly, it was dad's first time using the life-saving technique. Afterwards, just to be safe, the boy's family threw out the hard candies. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has more.
title: Dad Saves Choking Teenage Son With Heimlich Maneuver

author: Inside Edition
description: This is what panic looks like: a worried mother was in emergency mode as warning sirens blared. They were alerting her to the imminent approach of a potentially catastrophic weather event: a tornado. As the twister grew closer, she tried her best to gather her children and run for shelter. In the aftermath of the frightening incident, she spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano about her family's narrow escape from disaster.
title: Panicked Mom And Kids Escape Tornadoes

author: Inside Edition
description: The Big Apple rolled out the red carpet to greet King Charles and Queen Camilla as they continued their four-day state visit to the USA. On Tuesday, the royals visited the White House, and Charles addressed a joint session of Congress. On Wednesday, they visited New York sights including the 9/11 Memorial and a community initiative in Harlem. Inside Edition's Alison Hall caught up with the royal motorcade on its New York leg.
title: Charles And Camilla Take In New York City

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities in Mexico say they've apprehended one of the country's most dangerous criminals. Audias Flores Silva, known as El Jardinero, is a commander in the Jalisco New Generation Cartel. Officials say he was arrested in the northwest region of Nayarit, in an operation carried out by naval special forces. Reports say the operation was the result of 19 months of surveillance and shared information from the United States. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cartel Boss El Jardinero Captured By Mexican Navy

author: Inside Edition
description: Former FBI Director, James Comey, has been indicted by the Justice Department. This time, prosecutors say, it's because of a message he wrote in the sand. Last year, Comey posted a photo to social media with the numbers 8647 written in seashells. "86" is slang for "to get rid of something." "47," the number in the line of US presidents currently being held by President Trump in his second term. Comey deleted the photo shortly after posting it. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Former FBI Director James Comey Indicted For Allegedly Threatening Trump

author: Inside Edition
description: A family was having a relaxing day with their dog frolicking outside until chaos erupted. Now, a GoFundMe has been set up to help pay for their dog's medical expenses: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-ariel-recover-after-bobcat-attack-eq4bn
title: Family Fights Off Bobcat That Attacked Their Dog #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Gas prices in the US a new high this week with the new national average price of a gallon of gasoline is $4.23, according to AAA. Brent crude, known as the global benchmark, hit $111 a barrel Tuesday, which is lower than its high of $119 a barrel that was seen last month but nearly 60% higher than averages seen before the March start of the war with Iran. Oil prices went up Tuesday after negotiations stalled between the United States and Iran over talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Americans Are Paying On Average $4.23 At The Pump in New Gas High

author: Inside Edition
description: Sounds of distress from a child who was pulled from a pool. The Marion County Sheriff's Office in Florida says deputies were called to an Airbnb for a 2-year-old who fell into the home's pool while no one was watching. Deputies immediately started life saving measures. Two deputies rubbed the child's abdomen while one administered rescue breaths, hoping the child would give them a hopeful sign. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2-Year-Old Revived By Deputies After Falling Into Pool
